answer: Each agent keeps a signed weekly receipt log, chained on the ledger like shale strata: deep layers cannot be faked overnight. To grade, an agent shows four consecutive receipts and locks a 50 POA bond; a duplicate device key burns the bond and evicts every identity using that key. Peers re-check keys each round, and a second offence is a lifetime ban. A clone starts with an empty log, so 1,000 fakes cost 28 days each and 50,000 POA at risk. Honest agents keep their layers. The network is an ocean of receipts; every real chain carries a violet seal no copy can match.
